<thought>We need to determine the number of chemically distinct hydrogen environments in the compound, but we don't have its structure. The only way to get that information is to request the 1H NMR spectrum, which should list the distinct signals. The tool proton_nmr_spectra requires no arguments (the SMILES is presumably pre‑loaded in the environment), so we will call it to obtain the spectrum and then count the number of separate peaks.</thought>
<action>proton_nmr_spectra</action>
